blocks.text: A third former Montreal police officer has been charged in connection with the racism scandal at Station 39 in the Montréal-Nord borough. Last Saturday, two other former officers were arrested and charged.
Officer has been charged with assault, according to Crown prosecutor's office
Quebec’s Crown prosecutors’ office has announced charges against a third ex-police officer who had been working at Station 39 in the Montréal-Nord borough.
The Directeur des poursuites criminelles et pénales (DPCP) says one count of assault has been laid against the officer, who was arrested and will appear at the Montreal courthouse at a later date.
The DPCP says to avoid compromising the case before the courts, it won’t comment further.
Last Saturday, two other officers were arrested and charged with assault and breach of trust, with one of them facing an additional charge of criminal harassment.
